name: sdlc-workflow
description: Ticket-driven git workflow: resolve a Jira ticket (existing, new, or from a Slack thread), open a compliant branch, and enforce [TICKET-ID] commits and <type>/TICKET-ID-desc branch names with git hooks.

jiraProjectKey.title: Jira Project Key
jiraProjectKey.description: Default Jira project key for new tickets and the ticket-ID pattern (e.g. ABC for ABC-123). Leave empty to be prompted, or to use a permissive UPPERCASE-123 pattern in the git hooks.

jiraCloudId.title: Jira Cloud ID
jiraCloudId.description: Optional. Atlassian cloudId or site host (e.g. yoursite.atlassian.net). Leave empty to auto-discover from the authenticated Atlassian connector at runtime.

baseBranch.title: Base Branch
baseBranch.description: Branch new work is cut from. Leave empty to auto-detect the remote default (origin/HEAD), falling back to main.

defaultIssueType.title: Default Issue Type
defaultIssueType.description: Issue type used when creating a ticket and none is specified.

lintCommand.title: Pre-commit Lint Command
lintCommand.description: Optional check-only lint command run by the pre-commit hook on staged files (e.g. 'eslint' or 'ruff check'). Empty disables the pre-commit lint. Applied per-repo by the install step.
